    Careers Brillix

    Brillix is a professional services company (consulting and hands-on). Focusing on databases, data-pipelines, identity management and integration platforms.

    Senior DBA

    Brillix  Tel Aviv, Israel (Hybrid)


    Feeling that you are an accomplished DBA and that you need more diverse action and experience - we are looking for you.

    We are looking for experienced DBAs in relational and non-relational databases that like to challenge themselves in many data technologies.

    If you are like an expert in at least three different database technologies you have a place here.

    Brillix is a renowned consulting and professional services company specializing in data and identity technologies. We are looking for mature DBA's and pipeline experts who seek to become leaders in the field.

    As part of the team, you will be assigned to one or more customers which you will function as their external DBA. This will expose you to different requirements and different technique of doing things – enable a faster development and growth of oneself.


    Position requirement:

    • Strong understanding of database internals - mandatory

    • Sophisticated approach to database tuning - mandatory

    • At least one modern programming language basic skills (Java, Python, JS, etc') - mandatory

    • Experience with distributed topologies - AlwaysOn, Data Guard, Nosql grids - Advantage


    Challenge - What is a more efficient SQL query:

    1. Get the top record using an anlytical function;

    2. Get the top record using a sub-query;

    3. Get the top record using a self-join;

    Expert DBA

    Brillix  Tel Aviv, Israel (Hybrid)


    Brillix is providing professional services to the IT industry. We are looking for talented DBAs to join our team.

    As part of the team, you will be assigned to one or more customers which you will function as their external DBA. This will expose you to different requirements and different technique of doing things - enable a faster development and growth of oneself.


    Requirements:

    • Strong Oracle or MSSQL database infrastructure background - Mandatory

    • Fluent in PL/SQL or Transact SQL code writing – Mandatory

    • Good data modeling including normalization and de-normalization – Mandatory

    • Proven experience in backup and restore, high availability, query and database tuning - Mandatory

    • Good Linux/Windows background and shell scripting abilities – Advantage

    • Good understanding of network protocols – Advantage

    • Good understanding of storage protocols SAN/NAS NFS, CIFS - Advantage

    With us, you will be able to develop your skill set to more SQL database and NoSQLs (like MongoDB) alike, taking it to the next level.

    IAM Engineer

    Brillix IAM professional services team is the largest IAM team in Israel, with dozen of IAM projects working with variety of most advances IAM platforms such as Sailpoint, Okta, Thycotic and Oracle.

    In Brillix you will find yourself exposed to technologies and challenging work, our team collaboration makes our team a winning IAM leader.

    We are looking for those who likes to learn new technologies, to face challenges, to extend their horizon.

    If you think you are the right person come and join our growing team.


    Position Requirements:

    • 2 years Experience with any IAM solution administration and development of process / connectors / workflows – Mandatory

    • Well experienced with SQL statement writing – Mandatory

    • Experience with Linux OS - Mandatory

    • Experience with using SOAP/REST API functions – Mandatory

    • 2 years Experience Java scripting – Advantage

    • Experience coding in one of following: pyton, PS, Java scripts, Java, C++ - Mandatory
